method: Conservative growth at a reasonable price (GARP), rerun on the full US-listed market (StockAnalysis / S&P Global screener, Nov 13, 2026 close). A stock qualifies if it has: market cap of $10B or more and at least a year of trading history; TTM revenue growth of 15% or more that analysts expect to continue (consensus revenue growth of 8%+ next fiscal year and 8%+ a year over the next 3 years); a positive forward P/E of 35 or less and a PEG of 1.5 or less where available; a Buy or Strong Buy consensus from 5+ analysts with 15%+ upside to the average target; beta of 2.6 or less; share count up no more than 20% in a year (screens out stock-funded mergers); and at least $20M a day of trading volume. The 12 picks stay as long as they keep qualifying, and the ranked bench (best-first by a GARP score: revenue growth 35 (full at 75%+), PEG 25 (full at 0.3 or less; forward P/E when PEG is missing), upside 25 (full at 50%+), rating 15 (Strong Buy 15, Buy 10); at most two names per industry) refills any card you dismiss. Speculative, pre-profit and very high-beta names are left to the Risk It tab. Excludes bitcoin/crypto miners (including miners pivoting to AI/HPC hosting that still earn meaningful mining revenue). Excludes bitcoin/crypto miners and crypto-treasury companies (e.g. SBET, BMNR, MSTR).
dataNotes: Price, market cap, forward P/E, PEG, consensus rating, analyst count and average price target come from each company's StockAnalysis.com statistics page (S&P Global Market Intelligence) as of the Nov 13, 2026 close; TTM revenue growth and its period come from the StockAnalysis revenue page (where a fiscal year just ended, TTM equals that fiscal year); next-year revenue forecasts from the StockAnalysis forecast page. 97 US-listed stocks passed the screen today; 11 of the 12 picks still qualify (APP no longer qualified and were replaced from the top of the ranking), and the bench holds the next 18 by score. 'n/a' means the figure was not available. Excludes bitcoin/crypto miners (including miners pivoting to AI/HPC hosting that still earn meaningful mining revenue).
